scenario.topic: Pick the sustainability initiatives for next year's campus plan

options.name: Solar Panel Installation on Campus Buildings
options.upside: Reduces campus electricity costs and carbon emissions significantly.
options.concern: High upfront cost and requires structural assessments before installation.

options.name: Campus-wide Composting Program
options.upside: Engages students and staff in waste reduction and soil enrichment.
options.concern: Requires ongoing education and participation to maintain effectiveness.

options.name: Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Expansion
options.upside: Supports transition to electric vehicles and reduces fossil fuel use.
options.concern: Limited immediate impact if EV adoption remains low among campus users.

options.name: Green Roofs on Select Campus Buildings
options.upside: Improves building insulation and reduces stormwater runoff.
options.concern: Maintenance needs and structural suitability vary by building.

shared_context: The campus sustainability committee will select initiatives for next year's plan focusing on environmental impact, cost, and community engagement. Seven participants will decide among options that align with the campus's goals to reduce carbon footprint and promote green practices.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is an environmental science professor passionate about innovative green infrastructure.
personas.private_goal: Ensure initiatives improve campus sustainability with visible environmental benefits.

A.reason_for: Significantly reduces carbon emissions and electricity costs.
A.reason_against: High upfront cost and structural assessments could delay implementation.

B.reason_for: Engages the community and reduces waste effectively.
B.reason_against: Requires ongoing participation which may be inconsistent.

C.reason_for: Supports EV adoption, aligning with long-term campus goals.
C.reason_against: Low community involvement and limited immediate impact.

D.reason_for: Improves insulation and stormwater management, directly benefiting campus environment.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is the campus facilities manager focused on cost-effective sustainability solutions.
personas.private_goal: Prioritize initiatives with strong cost savings and measurable carbon reduction.

A.reason_for: High carbon reduction and electricity cost savings justify the upfront investment.

B.reason_for: Good community engagement and waste reduction.
B.reason_against: Ongoing education and participation make it less cost-effective.

C.reason_for: Supports EV transition with moderate cost and implementation time.
C.reason_against: Limited immediate impact if EV adoption is slow.

D.reason_for: Benefits building efficiency and stormwater management.
D.reason_against: Maintenance and structural variability increase costs.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a sustainability coordinator advocating for impactful carbon footprint reduction.
personas.private_goal: Maximize carbon reduction while balancing cost and feasibility.

A.reason_for: Largest carbon reduction and cost savings on electricity.

B.reason_for: Strong community involvement and waste diversion.
B.reason_against: Needs sustained participation to be effective.

C.reason_for: Encourages EV use, supporting sustainability goals.
C.reason_against: Low community involvement and slow adoption reduce impact.

D.reason_for: Improves building efficiency and environmental benefits.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a student affairs officer focused on engaging students in sustainability efforts.
personas.private_goal: Promote initiatives that maximize community involvement and education.

A.reason_for: Good environmental impact and cost savings.
A.reason_against: Less community involvement and high upfront cost.

B.reason_for: Highest community involvement and promotes active participation.

C.reason_for: Supports EV adoption but low community engagement.
C.reason_against: Limited immediate impact and low involvement.

D.reason_for: Environmental benefits but low community involvement.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a campus operations analyst with a cautious approach to new programs.
personas.private_goal: Avoid initiatives with high ongoing demands or uncertain participation.

A.reason_for: Strong carbon reduction but high cost and complex installation.
A.reason_against: Upfront cost and structural assessments are risky.

B.reason_for: Moderate cost and strong community involvement with tangible waste reduction.

C.reason_against: Low community involvement and uncertain impact.

D.reason_for: Improves insulation and stormwater management with moderate cost.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a student activist focused on community-driven sustainability projects.
personas.private_goal: Champion initiatives that actively involve students and staff in green practices.

A.reason_for: Strong environmental impact and cost savings.
A.reason_against: Less community involvement and upfront cost.

B.reason_for: Highest community involvement and promotes active participation.

C.reason_for: Supports EV adoption but low engagement.

D.reason_for: Environmental benefits but low community involvement.

personas.name: Tess
personas.background: Tess is a campus transportation planner focused on reducing fossil fuel dependency.
personas.private_goal: Prioritize infrastructure that encourages sustainable transportation modes.

A.reason_for: Strong carbon reduction and cost benefits.
A.reason_against: High upfront cost and installation complexity.

B.reason_for: Good community engagement but less direct impact on transportation emissions.

C.reason_for: Directly supports EV adoption and reduces fossil fuel use.

D.reason_for: Improves building efficiency but less relevant to transportation goals.
